videos.title: Is James Webb forcing us to rethink the early universe? | with Maggie Aderin
videos.author: The Royal Institution
videos.description:
Can the James Webb Space Telescope really see the past? Dame Maggie Aderin-Pocock returns to the Ri to explain what Webb is revealing about the early universe, from Saturn's aurorae to galaxies that seem to have formed earlier and faster than expected.

videos.title: Why some birds gave up flight | Steve Brusatte #shorts #science #birdevolution #dinosaurs #birds
videos.author: The Royal Institution
videos.description:
The cassowary... also known as the dinosaur that forgot to die. Steve Brusatte's full talk covers how we discovered the link between birds and dinosaurs, and then the science behind why our birds today are in fact surviving dinosaurs.
